io-0jgl.title: Plants: coastal coconut palm forests
io-0jgl.summary: Coastal palm forests make up a big part of the coverage, almost all coconut palms.

io-1BeC.title: Coverage: small atolls in the northern half
io-1BeC.summary: Coverage is mostly on small atolls in the northern half of the territory.

io-44Fc.title: Plants: mangroves
io-44Fc.summary: Mangroves grow on several of the atolls.

io-H0Km.title: Coverage: remote Indian Ocean atolls
io-H0Km.summary: A UK territory in the Indian Ocean, counted as the UK for streaks. None of it is pinpointable, so you rarely meet it in community maps.

io-ToF6.title: Landscape: sand beaches with palms
io-ToF6.summary: A lot of coverage is on sand beaches with many palm trees along them.

io-c13E.title: Landscape: grass fields with bushes and palms
io-c13E.summary: Some larger islands have grassy fields surrounded by bushes and palms.

io-ia3w.title: Coverage: Gen 3 trekker
io-ia3w.summary: Coverage is the older Gen 3 trekker, carried on foot (blurrier, softer colours).

io-lXGT.title: Coverage: trekker wading offshore
io-lXGT.summary: The trekker is sometimes walking in the water offshore.

io-qvfG.title: Landscape: small island, dark rocky shore
io-qvfG.summary: A small island with a dark rocky shore and a grassy field with no bushes or palm trees.

io-u9yO.title: Landmark: white shipwreck on the beach
io-u9yO.summary: A white, medium-sized shipwreck lies on the beach at the eastern tip of one island.
